fact: Curatella americana, commonly known as the wild cashew tree, sambaı́ba, and the sandpaper tree, is a species of tree in the family Dilleniaceae.

desc: Curatella americana, commonly known as the wild cashew tree, sambaı́ba, and the sandpaper tree, is a species of tree in the family Dilleniaceae. It is the sole accepted species in genus Curatella.

Curatella es un género monotípico de plantas perteneciente a la familia Dilleniaceae. Su única especie Curatella americana L. es originaria de América. Se conoce también con varios nombres comunes: bacabuey (Cuba), curata, chaparro (Venezuela), parica, peralejo macho, carne de fiambre, vacabuey. Se encuentra en las sabanas tropicales de América Central y el norte de América del Sur. Es el árbol que mejor tipifica el paisaje de las sabanas llaneras.

desc: Nicotiana tabacum, or cultivated tobacco, is an annually grown herbaceous plant of the genus Nicotiana. N. tabacum is the most commonly grown species in the genus Nicotiana, as the plant's leaves are commercially harvested to be processed into tobacco for human use. The plant is native to Bolivia, commonly grown throughout the world and often found in cultivation. It grows to heights between 1 and 2 metres. Research is ongoing into its ancestry among wild Nicotiana species, but it is believed to be a hybrid of Nicotiana sylvestris, N. tomentosiformis, and possibly N. otophora.

desc: The bicolored hawk is a species of bird of prey in the family Accipitridae. It is found in forest, woodland, second growth, plantations, and wooded savanna in southeastern Mexico, Central America, and northern and central South America. Though generally uncommon, it is the most common species of Astur in most of its range, but it does not occur at altitudes above 2,700 metres (8,900 ft) such as the highest parts of the Andes.

fact: The hairy-legged vampire bat is one of three extant species of vampire bats.

desc: The hairy-legged vampire bat is one of three extant species of vampire bats. It mainly feeds on the blood of wild birds, but can also feed both on domestic birds and humans. This vampire bat lives mainly in tropical and subtropical forestlands of South America, Central America, and southern Mexico. It is the sole member of the genus Diphylla.

Diphylla ecaudata es una especie de murciélago de la familia de los filostómidos. Se alimentan principalmente de sangre de aves silvestres, pero también puede alimentarse tanto de aves domésticas como de humanos. Es la única especie dentro del género Diphylla. Es una de las tres especies de murciélagos vampiros existentes en la actualidad.

fact: Sheep or domestic sheep are a domesticated ruminant mammal typically kept as livestock.

desc: Sheep or domestic sheep are a domesticated ruminant mammal typically kept as livestock. Although the term sheep can apply to other species in the genus Ovis, in everyday usage it almost always refers to domesticated sheep. Like all ruminants, sheep are members of the order Artiodactyla, the even-toed ungulates. There are around 1.2 billion domestic sheep as of 2019, making them easily the most common species of sheep. An adult female is referred to as a ewe ; an intact male as a ram, occasionally a tup; a castrated male as a wether; and a young sheep as a lamb.

La oveja es un mamífero cuadrúpedo ungulado doméstico, utilizado como ganado. Como todos los rumiantes, las ovejas son artiodáctilos. A pesar de que el término oveja se aplica a muchas especies del género Ovis, por lo general hace referencia a la subespecie doméstica de Ovis orientalis.

fact: The red-mantled saddlebags or red saddlebags is a species of skimmer dragonfly found in North America, Central America, and the Caribbean.
La libélula de alforjas rojas pertenece a la familia de las libélulas rayadoras (Libellulidae).
desc: The red-mantled saddlebags or red saddlebags is a species of skimmer dragonfly found in North America, Central America, and the Caribbean. It has translucent wings with red veins, and has characteristic dark red blotches at its proximal base, which makes the dragonfly look as if it is carrying saddlebags when flying. The last two bands and the cerci of these dragonflies are black.

La libélula de alforjas rojas pertenece a la familia de las libélulas rayadoras (Libellulidae). Tiene una distribución amplia y es común localmente dentro de su territorio, incluyendo áreas naturales protegidas, no hay indicios de declive poblacional 1. Como las otras especies del género presenta un vuelo estable y alto, generalmente no descendiendo a menos de 2 m de altura 2. Perchan en la punta de pastos altos y ramas donde tengan una clara visión de intrusos en campos abiertos o alrededor de estanques 2.
